**UC OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT**  
  
At the University of California (UC), your contributions make a difference. A world leader producing Nobel and Pulitzer Prize recipients with over 150 years of groundbreaking research transforming the world. Choose a career where you can leverage your knowledge, skills and aspirations to inspire and support some of the greatest minds in the world, and those who will follow in their footsteps. Working at the University of California is being part of a unique institution, and a vibrant and diverse community. At the University of California, Office of the President, we propel our mission through impactful work locally, in government centers and systemwide. We are passionate people, serving the greater good.  
  
The University of California, one of the largest and most acclaimed institutions of higher learning in the world, is dedicated to excellence in teaching, research and public service. The University of California Office of the President is the headquarters to the 10 campuses, six academic medical centers and three national laboratories and enrolls premier students from California, the nation and the world. Learn more about the UC Office of the President  
  
**Position Base**  
Oakland  
  
**Location**  
UCOP - Franklin Building  
  
**Department Overview**  
The Legal Practice Support Operations Team within UC Legal - Office of the General Counsel (UCL) provides legal services to the university, including representation, advice, research and training. We also provide legal opinions to the Board of Regents, administration, faculty, staff and others acting on the university's behalf. We report jointly to the Board of Regents and the president.  
  
**Position Summary**  
Reporting to the Legal Operations Manager, the Legal Operations Supervisor, Practice Support, provides direct supervision to Legal Support Specialist professionals and/or skilled technical employees. Functions as advisor to unit and administration. Analyzes and resolves problems, interprets policies (e.g., fiscal management, HR, contracts and grants, resource management in defined areas) and demonstrates solid subject matter knowledge. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and policies to determine appropriate action. Supervises staff to assure accountability and stewardship of department resources (operational, financial, and human) in compliance with departmental goals and objectives. Deploys legal support specialist staff across OGC practice areas. Ensures adequate resources and training to provide for smooth operations. The Legal Operations Supervisor, Practice Support, coordinates with the Legal Operations Manager and one or more practice groups and their attorneys to identify and fulfill resource and legal support needs. Collaborates with other Legal Support Specialist Supervisors and the Legal Operations Manager to meet overall UC Legal practice support needs locally and for systemwide support. Regularly presents and contributes in team meetings. Seeks out and participates in annual legal specialization or leadership professional development opportunities. All members of UC Legal are expected to promote and maintain an equitable and inclusive work environment by practicing UC Legal's established Values for Principles of Community.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  

* 50% Legal Practice Support • Partners with and Supports UC Health and Data Protection Senior Managing Counsel and Principal Counsel as their primary legal administrative support. * 30% Team Supervision and Leadership • Identifies, recommends, documents, and implements work process, automation and efficiency improvements. • Monitors, manages, and reviews performance for direct reports. • Consults with Legal Operations Manager and other LSS staff to assign work, and manage workflow, desk-balance, and proposed staffing changes. • Escalates performance related and workflow process issues to Legal Operations Manager and strategizes response and improvement plans across practice team. • Conducts the recruitment process for new hires. • Coordinates onboarding, and mentors and trains new Legal Support staff. • Assists with coordinating staffing changes across legal practice groups. • Ensures proper communicati

jobs.description:

Customer EngineeringField CTO

  

**We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

Cognition is the company behind Devin, the AI software engineer. We’re hiring an Executive Engagement Program Manager to coordinate how our executives, Field CTOs and Managing Directors participate in our global executive programs.

You’ll start with a plan for each leader: their expertise, priority audiences and relationships, key forums and available time. You’ll turn those plans into a coordinated calendar across summits, customer advisory boards, executive sponsorship, briefings, dinners and major industry gatherings.

A strong working partnership with Sales is essential. You’ll need to understand account priorities, ask the right questions about requests and make sound recommendations about where executive involvement will be most valuable. You’ll balance those needs with our program goals and executive capacity, communicating tradeoffs clearly and pushing back constructively when needed.

This role sits within Executive Engagement and works closely with program owners, executive assistants, regional marketing, Events and Communications. You’ll bring structure and continuity to the portfolio so our leaders spend their time thoughtfully and each customer interaction builds on the last.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Build executive engagement plans. Understand each leader’s priorities, expertise, existing relationships and capacity, then maintain a proactive plan for their participation.
* Partner with Sales on priorities. Build trust with sales leaders and account teams. Understand which senior relationships matter, the customer’s priorities and why a particular executive or program would be valuable.
* Manage and prioritize requests. Establish a clear intake process that captures the audience, purpose, relationship context, timing and expected value of each request. Assess requests against agreed priorities, executive fit and capacity.
* Exercise judgment and communicate tradeoffs. Recommend what to accept, defer, redirect or decline. Offer alternatives where appropriate and route assignment decisions and escalations to the right owner.
* Coordinate the global calendar. Align executive hosts, audiences, preparation deadlines and commitments across programs. Identify conflicts and gaps early.
* Maintain continuity. Keep a shared record of participation, feedback and commitments. Ensure follow-up has a named owner and carries through between programs.
* Keep the team aligned. Run planning meetings, surface decisions and report on participation, capacity and program feedback.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Experience managing executive programs, executive briefings, customer advisory boards or similar programs in an enterprise environment.
* A demonstrated ability to partner with sales, understand account priorities and translate requests into well-defined executive engagements.
* Strong prioritization skills. You can distinguish an urgent request from a strategically important one, assess competing needs and explain your recommendations.
* Confidence asking sales leaders and account teams for context, challenging assumptions and pushing back constructively.
* Experience working with senior executives and their assistants, with sound judgment about how to use limited executive time.
* Clear, concise writing and experience preparing executive briefing materials.
* Strong organizational skills, discretion and attention to detail.
* The ability to build practical processes and personally manage the details required to make them work.

**Our Commitment**
------------------

**Equal Opportunity.** Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process - please let us know if you need any. Cognition also considers applicants with criminal histories consistent with the SF Fair Chance Ordinance and similar local laws.

**Data Privacy and Arbitration:** By submitting your application, you agree to our Global Applicant and Job Candidate Privacy Notice. For US applicants, by submitting your application, you agree to the Applicant Arbitration Agreement.

jobs.description:
**Location**

San Francisco, CA

**Employment Type**

Sales & Success

**Compensation**
----------------

* Zone 1Estimated Base Salary $110K – $127K • Offers Commission

Individual compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, training, and market conditions. At Front, we take a market-based approach to pay. In addition to cash compensation (base salary, which may include commissions or overtime pay where applicable), Fronteers are eligible to receive equity in the company. This resource will provide additional information on our location zone designations. If you have questions, please contact a member of our recruiting team for additional information.

Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer-facing work actually succeed.

Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous accolades, including a **Certified Great Place to Work in 2026,** **Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025**, **Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023**, **#4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™** ,**Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list**, and **Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List**.

As an Account Manager at Front, you will own the commercial health and growth of a portfolio of customers. This is a relationship-driven role where you’ll manage renewals, uncover expansion opportunities, and help customers get more value from Front over time.

You’ll partner closely with a dedicated Customer Success Manager (CSM). While the CSM focuses on product adoption and value realization, you will own the commercial relationship—building trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, navigating complex opportunities, and delivering predictable revenue outcomes. This role is a great fit for someone who combines commercial acumen, customer empathy, and operational rigor.

**What will you be doing?**

* **Own the commercial lifecycle:** Manage renewals and expansion opportunities across a portfolio of core customers, from early planning through negotiation and close.
* **Drive revenue growth:** Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, run thoughtful discovery, build business cases, negotiate contracts, and close commercial deals.
* **Build trusted customer relationships:** Develop strong relationships with customer stakeholders and understand their goals, challenges, and evolving business needs.
* Position Front’s broader value: Introduce AI capabilities like Autopilot, Professional Services, premium support, and other relevant offerings to help customers automate workflows, accelerate time-to-value, and expand their use of Front.
* **Partner with Customer Success:** Collaborate closely with your mapped CSM to use product usage data, health signals, and customer feedback to drive expansion and mitigate churn risk.
* **Lead strategic account planning:** Create and execute account plans that align customer priorities with Front’s capabilities and identify paths to long-term growth.
* **Maintain operational excellence:** Keep accurate CRM records, manage pipeline, forecast renewals and expansion, and consistently track customer and commercial activity.
* **Collaborate cross-functionally:** Partner with Sales, Support, Product, Marketing, and Services to resolve issues, advocate for customer feedback, and improve the customer experience.

**What skills and experience do you need?**

* **Experience:** 3–5 years in Account Management, Customer Success, or a related commercial role, ideally managing and growing a portfolio of SaaS customers.
* **Commercial acumen:** A track record of owning revenue outcomes, including renewals, upsell, cross-sell, or expansion in a quota-carrying or metrics-driven environment.
* **Customer relationship skills:** Ability to build credibility with a range of stakeholders, understand business priorities, and communicate value clearly.
* **Strategic and consultative approach:** Strong discovery, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect customer needs to practical solutions.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Experience partnering with Customer Success, Support, Product, Services, and other teams to deliver customer and business outcomes.
* **Operational rigor:** Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities, timelines, and stakeholders without losing momentum.
* **Data fluency:** Ability to interpret customer usage, engagement, and health data to prioritize action and make informed commercial decisions.
* AI fluency: Comfort leveraging AI tools and Front’s AI capabilities to improve productivity, identify customer opportunities, and demonstrate value.
* **SaaS experience:** Experience working in B2B SaaS is required; experience with customer experience, support, collaboration, or communications products is a plus.

**Front operates on a hybrid model — we come together in the office each Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to collaborate and stay connected.**

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary
* Equity (we are post-series D & backed by some of the best VCs in the US)
* Private health insurance, including plan options at no cost to employees
* Paid parental leave
* Flexible time off policy
*

jobs.title: Program Coordinator - Hybrid/Remote
jobs.description:
Spatial GIS Services (SpatialGIS) is a small business federal contractor dedicated to delivering high-impact solutions for government agencies and academic institutions. We are currently seeking an organized and detail-oriented Program Coordinator to support an upcoming federal program designed to help colleges and universities strengthen their research administration capabilities and successfully compete for federal research funding.

Note: This position is contingent upon the award of the contract.

#### **About the Role**

In this role, you will play an essential part in managing administrative workflows, coordinating program schedules, and supporting outreach initiatives. You will work closely with program leadership, participating colleges and universities, staff, and stakeholders to ensure seamless operational execution.

Key Responsibilities (What You Will Do)

Schedule & Logistics Coordination: Coordinate program schedules, meetings, and comprehensive event logistics.

Documentation & Records: Keep meticulous meeting minutes and maintain organized program records.

Travel Management: Plan and track staff travel in strict accordance with the Federal Travel Regulation (FTR).

On-Site Outreach: Help run on-site outreach events, workshops, and conferences.

Qualifications & Requirements (What You Need)

Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s degree and at least 4 years of program coordination experience (or an equivalent combination of education and experience).

Core Competencies: Demonstrated practical experience with scheduling, maintaining meeting minutes, records management, and travel planning under the Federal Travel Regulation (FTR).

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

Previous experience in federal contracting environments or university-sponsored programs.

Experience working collaboratively with Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) and minority-serving institutions.

Spatial GIS Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

#### **About SpatialGIS LLC**

SpatialGIS is at the forefront of geospatial intelligence, offering innovative solutions that integrate geographic information systems (GIS), comprehensive data management, and sophisticated system implementations. Our mission is to empower organizations to make informed decisions by providing actionable insights through spatial data.

United States - Remote

JOB ID: R-260775 LOCATION: United States - Remote WORK LOCATION TYPE: Remote DATE POSTED: Nov. 06, 2026 CATEGORY: Medical Affairs SALARY RANGE: 154,358.30USD -208,837.70 USD

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
--------------------------------------------

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

  
  

**Field Medical Onboarding & Capability Development, US FME**
-------------------------------------------------------------

  
  

**What you will do**
--------------------

  
  

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will partner with stakeholders across US Field Medical Leadership, Global Field Medical Excellence, Knowledge & Learning, HR, and other cross-functional partners to as the responsible for designing and delivering a consistent, high-quality learning and development experience across the US Field Medical colleague lifecycle.

The role supports colleagues joining US Field Medical, including Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs), Field Directors, and the MVPH team, and strengthens the continued education, professional skills, and capabilities of experienced MSLs and field leaders. This role will lead the strategy and evolution of Field Medical onboarding and ongoing capability development, translating business needs, evolving scientific engagement expectations, adult learning principles, and emerging technologies into practical learning experiences that accelerate readiness, sustain effectiveness, and support continued growth in role.

The individual will work across therapeutic areas and functions to establish common learning standards while enabling appropriate customization for role, experience level, and therapeutic-area needs. The position has a future-focused orientation, regularly evaluating emerging trends in healthcare, scientific engagement, learning practices, technology, and AI to ensure Field Medical colleagues are prepared for an evolving external environment throughout their careers. Main responsibilities include:

  
  

* Partner closely with therapeutic-area Knowledge & Learning leads, Field Directors, and TA leadership to define onboarding objectives, learning pathways, and developmental milestones that support new hire preparedness and effectiveness in external scientific engagement.
* Design and maintain a connected learning and development approach that bridges onboarding with continuous education, professional skills development, and ongoing capability growth for tenured MSLs and field leaders.
* Partner with therapeutic-area leadership and subject matter experts to identify common enterprise learning needs and determine where customization is required.
* Apply adult learning, instructional design, and performance-support principles to create engaging, practical, and scalable learning experiences for colleagues at different career stages.
* Develop and continuously improve learning resources and experiences, including structured onboarding journeys, continuing education, workshops, simulations, practice opportunities, field-based learning, performance support, and self-directed resources.
* Identify and advance professional skills learning for MSLs, including capabilities such as communication, strategic thinking, business acumen, emotional intelligence, self-leadership, and AI fluency and judgment, aligned to evolving Field Medical expectations.
* Refine coaching resources and tools for Field Directors and other people leaders to strengthen their role in onboarding, field coaching, ongoing development, and application of learning.
* Support career development and continued capability growth by connecting onboarding and continuing education with broader professional capability and development frameworks.
* Incorporate emerging technologies, including AI-enabled learning and performance-support solutions, where they can improve learning effectiveness, personalization, accessibility, or efficiency.
* Create mechanisms to gather learner and stakeholder feedback, identify emerging capability gaps across both new and experienced colleagues, and translate insights into improvements in learning strategy and design.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  
  

* Doctorate degree and 2 years of Medical Science Liaison, Medical Affairs, learning and development, or other relevant experience, OR
* Master's degree and 4 years of Medical Affairs, learning and development, instructional design, organizational development, or other relevant experience, OR
* Bachelor's degree and 6 years of Medical Affairs, learning and development, instructional design, organizational development, or other relevant experience
  

  

**What you can expect of us**
-----------------------------

  
  

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Lead construction projects from planning through delivery, bringing teams, schedules, budgets, and field operations into alignment. As a Project Manager, you’ll coordinate complex infrastructure or commercial construction work, keep stakeholders informed, and address issues before they disrupt progress. Your impact: Clear coordination and cost control help project teams deliver safe, compliant work that serves clients and communities.

**Duties**

* Manage project scope, budgets, contracts, schedules, and construction documentation.
* Coordinate project scheduling, site activities, subcontractors, and internal teams; lead teams in a construction management role.
* Review construction plans, blueprints, schematics, and site conditions to support estimating, planning, and execution.
* Track costs, schedule changes, risks, and regulatory compliance; maintain accurate project records.
* Use construction management and project management software to coordinate work and report progress.

**Requirements**

* Construction experience, including construction site experience; commercial construction experience is preferred.
* Experience in project management, construction project management, project coordination, cost management, construction budget management, project leadership, and construction schedule coordination.
* Knowledge of construction regulations, construction regulatory compliance, construction scheduling, construction estimating, and construction management.

**UC OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT**  
  
At the University of California (UC), your contributions make a difference. A world leader producing Nobel and Pulitzer Prize recipients with over 150 years of groundbreaking research transforming the world. Choose a career where you can leverage your knowledge, skills and aspirations to inspire and support some of the greatest minds in the world, and those who will follow in their footsteps. Working at the University of California is being part of a unique institution, and a vibrant and diverse community. At the University of California, Office of the President, we propel our mission through impactful work locally, in government centers and systemwide. We are passionate people, serving the greater good.  
  
The University of California, one of the largest and most acclaimed institutions of higher learning in the world, is dedicated to excellence in teaching, research and public service. The University of California Office of the President is the headquarters to the 10 campuses, six academic medical centers and three national laboratories and enrolls premier students from California, the nation and the world. Learn more about the UC Office of the President  
  
**Department Overview**  
As a security first organization, UC Digital Risk & Security (UCDRS) is part of the Digital Innovation & Technology (DigIT) Department. The UCDRS teams include UCOP local and system-wide information security and risk teams focused on providing cyber security services to the UC system. We maintain an innovative, inclusive, and supportive work environment.  
  
**Position Summary**  
Reporting to the Deputy Chief Information Security Officer, the Security Operations Manager is responsible for monitoring, detecting, protecting, and maintaining the security of data, systems, and networks at UCOP. This role includes managing the UCOP Security Operations team, monitoring the UCOP infrastructure for malicious activity, developing and implementing security processes and procedures, managing vulnerabilities, and coordinating security incident response. The Security Operations Manager will work closely with other units at UCOP, including infrastructure and application development teams, desktop engineering, and the service desk, to identify vulnerabilities, implement best practices, and ensure the security of the UCOP computing environment.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
50% Responsible for managing the daily activities of Security Operations security analysts who plan, design, develop, implement and maintain systems and programs to ensure the integrity, reliability and security of UCOP data and systems, and monitor and respond to threats to the UCOP computing environment. Additionally, this role provides mentoring to security personnel, drives continuous improvement, fosters an inclusive culture, and aligns the team with UCOP's mission and goals.  
  
25% Implements highly complex and broad-scale security controls to prevent unauthorized access or changes to institutional information, information systems, and / or network infrastructure. Responsible for providing research, analysis and solutions to address attempted efforts to compromise security protocols. Proactively addresses the negative impact on Office of the President caused by theft, destruction, alteration or denial of access of information. Advises departments on security prevention, best practices and secure software.  
  
10% Designs, configures and manages complex security systems including data loss prevention software, security information and event management systems, vulnerability scanners, and endpoint security agents. Administers security configurations to control access to information systems and networks including on premise and cloud environments.  
  
10% Directs incident response and forensic investigations and addresses and produces reports in response to highly complex or broad-scale security incidents. Applies advanced IT security concepts, compliance and regulatory requirements, and policies and procedures to respond to and appropriately escalate security incidents.

Ability to lead a highly technical team.  

Advanced interpersonal skills to work effectively with both technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.  
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate orally and in writing, to include writing and preparing technical and executive reports, briefings, and recommendations.

Advanced experience using IT security systems and tools and using those tools to apply security controls in a complex environment.  
Advanced experience analyzing, researching, and implementing threat intelligence and novel security concepts to improve overall security in a complex environment.

jobs.description:
$125,000 to $140,000 At Outform Group, our guiding philosophy is Dare To Innovate.  
  
Outform Group specializes in creating tangible consumer engagements that elevate, connect and humanize brand experiences. We unite leading experts in research, strategy, design, innovation and manufacturing, who work together to create unforgettable brand experiences.  
  
Lean, interdisciplinary teams work in close collaboration with clients, helping them to solve their user’s biggest problems. Our user-centric, data-driven approach focuses on creating a seamless experience across different environments.

**COMPENSATION RANGE: $125,000 to $140,000**

The Senior Account Manager, Consumer Electronics is a senior commercial leadership role within Outform's Consumer Electronics Vertical, accountable for deepening the level of strategic support delivered to Outform's consumer electronics clients and driving topline growth across assigned accounts. This role is responsible for elevating Outform's credibility and value as a trusted partner across the consumer electronics landscape through strategic account leadership, exceptional execution, and enduring client relationships.

This individual will serve as the primary point of contact for the brand, acting as both the voice of the client internally and the voice of Outform externally. The role owns the strategic development, execution, and growth of all client-funded initiatives within assigned accounts, while guiding internal teams through complex, cross-functional programs. A core measure of success is revenue and margin growth driven by client initiatives and account-funded projects.

**DIRECT REPORTS**

* N/A (This position operates as a senior individual contributor with cross-functional leadership accountability.)

**SCOPE & ACCOUNTABILITY**

* Own the strategic and commercial relationship between Outform and assigned consumer electronics accounts, including related brands and initiatives.
* Serve as Outform's senior ambassador within each client organization, embodying the excellence, values, and mission of The Outform Group.
* Drive topline revenue growth and contribution margin performance directly tied to assigned account programs.
* Lead complex, multi-project pipelines involving design, engineering, manufacturing, and installation.
* Translate client strategies, priorities, and ways of working into actionable internal plans.
* Act as the internal leader and driver of best-practice ways of working specific to each account.
* Identify and develop additional brand and program opportunities within the consumer electronics ecosystem.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client Relationship & Strategic Account Leadership**

* Build, maintain, and deepen senior-level and day-to-day relationships across each client organization—from C-suite to operational teams.
* Leverage ongoing client insights to inform Outform's strategy on the right projects, pricing, scope, and internal resourcing.
* Act as a trusted advisor and strategic growth agent, guiding Outform toward next-level revenue and partnership opportunities.

**Revenue Growth & Commercial Ownership**

* Own topline revenue growth across assigned accounts, including forecasting, pipeline management, and margin performance.
* Identify internal step-changes required to achieve growth targets and proactively partner with leadership to execute improvements.
* Maintain a detailed, project-based pipeline and revenue forecast using established reporting tools.

**Project Oversight & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Oversee day-to-day execution of client RFPs, RFQs, speculative projects, and active programs.
* Strategically guide and partner with global cross-functional Outform teams—Design, Engineering, Project Management, Operations, Manufacturing, and Production—to position Outform to win and deliver work.
* Ensure alignment to client timelines, standards, budgets, and expectations.

**Vertical & Internal Partnership**

* Partner closely with the VP, Consumer Electronics to share client insights—what's working, what's not, and what's next.
* Inform commercial, pricing, and operational strategies using client-driven intelligence.
* Support development of a cohesive, long-term growth plan aligned with both client and Outform goals.

**Market & Brand Opportunity Identification**

* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the branded landscape within each client organization.
* Identify and pursue direct brand-funded display and merchandising opportunities aligned to Outform's capabilities.

**KEY INTERFACES (NON-REPORTING)**

* VP, Consumer Electronics Vertical
* Design & Creative
* Engineering
* Project Management
* Operations & Manufacturing
* Production
* Finance
* Client Partners (Visual Merchandising, Procurement, Operations)

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Success in this role will be measured against metrics including but not limited to:
* Revenue growth from client-funded initiatives across assigned accounts.
* Contribution margin performance vs. established targets.
* Accuracy and effectiveness of project-based revenue forecasting and pipeline management.
* Strength, depth, and longevity of client relationships.
* Quality and consistency of execution across all account initiatives.
* Identification and conversion of new programmatic and brand opportunities.
* Elevated service levels and establishment of long-term, sustainable partnership models.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

**Experience**

* Minimum 10 years in a commercial or client service role within the industry, on the agency, brand, or retailer side.
* Experience or knowledge of the consumer electronics landscape and its retail/distribution channels.
* Minimum 5 years managing strategic accounts with annual revenues of $10M+.
* Proven experience driving growth within complex, multi-stakeholder client organizations.

**LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES & PERSONAL CHARACTER

jobs.title: TAX PROFESSIONAL – OFFICE MANAGER
jobs.description:
TAX PROFESSIONAL – MANAGER

**Dominique Taylor Tax Services, LLC**  
Website: www.dtaylortax.org

**Position:** Tax Professional – Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Part-Time / Seasonal  
**Location:** Remote  
**Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience and qualifications

Position Overview

Dominique Taylor Tax Services, LLC is seeking an experienced, motivated, and client-focused **Tax Professional – Manager** to oversee tax preparation operations, lead tax preparation personnel, and ensure the delivery of accurate, efficient, and high-quality tax services.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive knowledge of federal and state income tax preparation, strong leadership and organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

This position requires a hands-on manager who can prepare and review individual and business tax returns while providing guidance, training, and operational oversight to the tax preparation team. The Tax Professional – Manager will play an important role in maintaining the company's professional standards, strengthening client relationships, and supporting continued business growth.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

**Tax Preparation & Quality Control**

* Prepare and review individual federal and state income tax returns.
* Prepare and review business tax returns, including applicable small business filings.
* Ensure tax returns are accurate, complete, and compliant with current IRS and state tax regulations.
* Identify applicable deductions, credits, and tax-saving opportunities for clients.
* Review complex tax returns and assist with resolving preparation issues.
* Maintain current knowledge of federal and state tax laws, regulations, and filing requirements.

**Team Leadership & Management**

* Supervise, coordinate, and support tax preparers and administrative personnel.
* Assign client accounts and manage workflow to ensure timely completion of returns.
* Monitor employee productivity, accuracy, and performance.
* Provide training, guidance, and technical assistance to tax preparation staff.
* Establish and maintain quality-control procedures.
* Address operational challenges and escalate complex tax matters when necessary.

**Client Relations & Business Operations**

* Maintain professional relationships with new and existing clients.
* Assist clients with tax-related questions and document requests.
* Handle escalated client concerns and resolve service issues professionally.
* Oversee client intake, document collection, return processing, and filing procedures.
* Monitor filing deadlines and ensure timely submission of completed returns.
* Support client retention, referrals, and business development initiatives.
* Assist with implementing procedures that improve office efficiency and customer experience.

**Compliance & Confidentiality**

* Maintain strict confidentiality of taxpayer information and financial records.
* Ensure compliance with IRS regulations, applicable state requirements, and company policies.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and secure handling of client records.
* Follow applicable taxpayer data security and information protection requirements.

Qualifications & Experience

* Minimum of 3–5 years of professional tax preparation experience.
* Demonstrated experience preparing individual federal and state income tax returns.
* Experience with small business tax returns preferred.
* Prior supervisory, team leadership, or management experience strongly preferred.
* Active IRS Preparer Tax Identification Number (PTIN).
* Strong working knowledge of federal and state tax laws and regulations.
* Proficiency with professional tax preparation software.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage competing deadlines.
* Demonstrated commitment to accuracy, professionalism, and client service.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience managing a tax preparation office or team.
* Experience with tax return review and quality assurance.
* Enrolled Agent (EA), CPA, or other relevant tax credentials are a plus, but not required.
* Experience with tax resolution, amended returns, and prior-year tax filings.
* Experience implementing office procedures and improving operational performance.

Key Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be expected to:

* Maintain high standards of tax preparation accuracy.
* Ensure efficient workflow and timely filing of tax returns.
* Provide effective leadership and support to the tax preparation team.
* Deliver an exceptional client experience.
* Maintain compliance with applicable tax laws and company procedures.
* Contribute to the company's continued growth and operational success.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a dependable, knowledgeable, and results-driven tax professional who takes pride in their work and understands that successful tax preparation requires more than completing returns. The ideal candidate is a natural leader who can balance technical tax expertise with team management, operational accountability, and exceptional customer service.

**Join Dominique Taylor Tax Services, LLC and become part of a team committed to professionalism, accuracy, and delivering quality tax services to the clients and communities we serve.**

Equal Employment Opportunity

Dominique Taylor Tax Services, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to protected characteristics under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Pay: $30,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer-facing work actually succeed.

Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous accolades, including a **Certified Great Place to Work in 2026,** **Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025**, **Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023**, **#4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™** ,**Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list**, and **Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List**.

As an Account Manager at Front, you will own the commercial health and growth of a portfolio of customers. This is a relationship-driven role where you’ll manage renewals, uncover expansion opportunities, and help customers get more value from Front over time.

You’ll partner closely with a dedicated Customer Success Manager (CSM). While the CSM focuses on product adoption and value realization, you will own the commercial relationship—building trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, navigating complex opportunities, and delivering predictable revenue outcomes. This role is a great fit for someone who combines commercial acumen, customer empathy, and operational rigor.

**What will you be doing?**

* **Own the commercial lifecycle:** Manage renewals and expansion opportunities across a portfolio of core customers, from early planning through negotiation and close.
* **Drive revenue growth:** Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, run thoughtful discovery, build business cases, negotiate contracts, and close commercial deals.
* **Build trusted customer relationships:** Develop strong relationships with customer stakeholders and understand their goals, challenges, and evolving business needs.
* Position Front’s broader value: Introduce AI capabilities like Autopilot, Professional Services, premium support, and other relevant offerings to help customers automate workflows, accelerate time-to-value, and expand their use of Front.
* **Partner with Customer Success:** Collaborate closely with your mapped CSM to use product usage data, health signals, and customer feedback to drive expansion and mitigate churn risk.
* **Lead strategic account planning:** Create and execute account plans that align customer priorities with Front’s capabilities and identify paths to long-term growth.
* **Maintain operational excellence:** Keep accurate CRM records, manage pipeline, forecast renewals and expansion, and consistently track customer and commercial activity.
* **Collaborate cross-functionally:** Partner with Sales, Support, Product, Marketing, and Services to resolve issues, advocate for customer feedback, and improve the customer experience.

**What skills and experience do you need?**

* **Experience:** 3–5 years in Account Management, Customer Success, or a related commercial role, ideally managing and growing a portfolio of SaaS customers.
* **Commercial acumen:** A track record of owning revenue outcomes, including renewals, upsell, cross-sell, or expansion in a quota-carrying or metrics-driven environment.
* **Customer relationship skills:** Ability to build credibility with a range of stakeholders, understand business priorities, and communicate value clearly.
* **Strategic and consultative approach:** Strong discovery, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect customer needs to practical solutions.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Experience partnering with Customer Success, Support, Product, Services, and other teams to deliver customer and business outcomes.
* **Operational rigor:** Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities, timelines, and stakeholders without losing momentum.
* **Data fluency:** Ability to interpret customer usage, engagement, and health data to prioritize action and make informed commercial decisions.
* AI fluency: Comfort leveraging AI tools and Front’s AI capabilities to improve productivity, identify customer opportunities, and demonstrate value.
* **SaaS experience:** Experience working in B2B SaaS is required; experience with customer experience, support, collaboration, or communications products is a plus.

**Front operates on a hybrid model — we come together in the office each Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to collaborate and stay connected.**

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary
* Equity (we are post-series D & backed by some of the best VCs in the US)
* Private health insurance, including plan options at no cost to employees
* Paid parental leave
* Flexible time off policy
*

**Project Oversight & Cross-Functional Leadership**

new_jobs.title: TAX PROFESSIONAL – OFFICE MANAGER
new_jobs.description:
TAX PROFESSIONAL – MANAGER

**Dominique Taylor Tax Services, LLC**  
Website: www.dtaylortax.org

**Position:** Tax Professional – Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Part-Time / Seasonal  
**Location:** Remote  
**Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience and qualifications

Position Overview

Dominique Taylor Tax Services, LLC is seeking an experienced, motivated, and client-focused **Tax Professional – Manager** to oversee tax preparation operations, lead tax preparation personnel, and ensure the delivery of accurate, efficient, and high-quality tax services.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive knowledge of federal and state income tax preparation, strong leadership and organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

This position requires a hands-on manager who can prepare and review individual and business tax returns while providing guidance, training, and operational oversight to the tax preparation team. The Tax Professional – Manager will play an important role in maintaining the company's professional standards, strengthening client relationships, and supporting continued business growth.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

**Tax Preparation & Quality Control**

* Prepare and review individual federal and state income tax returns.
* Prepare and review business tax returns, including applicable small business filings.
* Ensure tax returns are accurate, complete, and compliant with current IRS and state tax regulations.
* Identify applicable deductions, credits, and tax-saving opportunities for clients.
* Review complex tax returns and assist with resolving preparation issues.
* Maintain current knowledge of federal and state tax laws, regulations, and filing requirements.

**Team Leadership & Management**

* Supervise, coordinate, and support tax preparers and administrative personnel.
* Assign client accounts and manage workflow to ensure timely completion of returns.
* Monitor employee productivity, accuracy, and performance.
* Provide training, guidance, and technical assistance to tax preparation staff.
* Establish and maintain quality-control procedures.
* Address operational challenges and escalate complex tax matters when necessary.

**Client Relations & Business Operations**

* Maintain professional relationships with new and existing clients.
* Assist clients with tax-related questions and document requests.
* Handle escalated client concerns and resolve service issues professionally.
* Oversee client intake, document collection, return processing, and filing procedures.
* Monitor filing deadlines and ensure timely submission of completed returns.
* Support client retention, referrals, and business development initiatives.
* Assist with implementing procedures that improve office efficiency and customer experience.

**Compliance & Confidentiality**

* Maintain strict confidentiality of taxpayer information and financial records.
* Ensure compliance with IRS regulations, applicable state requirements, and company policies.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and secure handling of client records.
* Follow applicable taxpayer data security and information protection requirements.

Qualifications & Experience

* Minimum of 3–5 years of professional tax preparation experience.
* Demonstrated experience preparing individual federal and state income tax returns.
* Experience with small business tax returns preferred.
* Prior supervisory, team leadership, or management experience strongly preferred.
* Active IRS Preparer Tax Identification Number (PTIN).
* Strong working knowledge of federal and state tax laws and regulations.
* Proficiency with professional tax preparation software.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage competing deadlines.
* Demonstrated commitment to accuracy, professionalism, and client service.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience managing a tax preparation office or team.
* Experience with tax return review and quality assurance.
* Enrolled Agent (EA), CPA, or other relevant tax credentials are a plus, but not required.
* Experience with tax resolution, amended returns, and prior-year tax filings.
* Experience implementing office procedures and improving operational performance.

Key Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be expected to:

* Maintain high standards of tax preparation accuracy.
* Ensure efficient workflow and timely filing of tax returns.
* Provide effective leadership and support to the tax preparation team.
* Deliver an exceptional client experience.
* Maintain compliance with applicable tax laws and company procedures.
* Contribute to the company's continued growth and operational success.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a dependable, knowledgeable, and results-driven tax professional who takes pride in their work and understands that successful tax preparation requires more than completing returns. The ideal candidate is a natural leader who can balance technical tax expertise with team management, operational accountability, and exceptional customer service.

**Join Dominique Taylor Tax Services, LLC and become part of a team committed to professionalism, accuracy, and delivering quality tax services to the clients and communities we serve.**

Equal Employment Opportunity

Dominique Taylor Tax Services, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to protected characteristics under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Pay: $30,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote
